desc:
It is STRONGLY RECOMMENDED your device has 4+ GB RAM to avoid crashes. Older devices may GREATLY STRUGGLE to run the game as intended! The experience is best for new devices (2023+) that can run on high graphics settings!

⭐Beta Testing⭐
UNFINISHED WORK IN PROGRESS - please send us bug reports to improve the game!
Opened Jan 25!

The NPCs are NOT chatbots and run on basic dialogue algorithms - NO generative AI or LLM was used. The game is a LIFE SIM, not a chatbot hangout.

❗PERFORMANCE UPDATE❗
Spooky items, mobile upgrades, and smoother gameplay!

🌇🏡 Destination 🌇🏡 is a dynamic life sim with up to 1500 NPCs roaming the world. These NPCs are quite reactive, so interactions may cause funny dialogue and events! Progress different careers, save money, and build your dream homes!

*Early Access server size is temporarily decreased from 36 to 35 - will return after a minor update.*

Genres: Life Simulation, Building, Roleplay (RP), NPC & AI, Hangout, Town & City, Cars
